title: A refused Cancel changes the host to OFF before connection creation ends.
realistic_sequence: The probe uses blec_init and blec_start. Successful command events complete Reset, masks, buffers, random address and scan setup.
An SMC advertising report starts scan disable. Its successful completion submits LE Create Connection.
Successful Create Command Status leaves the host in CONNECTING with step 8, waiting 0 and no connection handle.
The transport then refuses LE Create Connection Cancel when blec_stop runs.
The transport recovers. A successful LE Connection Complete event arrives before the stop deadline.
The probe checks legacy and enhanced connection events. Their parameter lengths are 19 and 31 bytes.
The event connection interval is 24. The supervision timeout is 400.
expected: A refused Cancel must retain the pending creation and stop intent. A successful connection must retain its handle for Disconnect.

observed.accepted_cancel_control: Both event variants retain handle 0x50 and submit one Disconnect. Both controls pass.
observed.refused_cancel: Cancel has one refusal and no acceptance. The host changes to OFF with waiting 0 and no connection handle.
observed.later_success: Both event variants leave the host OFF with handle 0 and no Disconnect submission.
observed.functional_result: Both no-loss assertions fail with return code -6. No sanitizer error precedes either assertion.

cause: blec_command sets waiting only after transport acceptance. blec_stop interprets waiting 0 and conn 0 as completed stop. blec_event ignores all events in OFF.
consequence: The simulated controller reports a successful link. The host discards that handle and submits no Disconnect. Stop reports OFF before it ends creation.
production_consumer: ble_central_service calls blec_stop before it drains incoming HCI events. With ble_want 0, its later poll cannot recover an OFF state.
scope: The complete candidate includes stop, cancel and transport-refusal behaviour. This is a source defect. The probe does not establish a physical regression cause.
coverage_gap: The public cancel tests assume transport acceptance of Cancel. They cover the successful-connection race after that acceptance.
disposition: Use a fresh stage2 for the source repair. Then use a fresh stage3. Do not advance this candidate to stage4.
limits: HCI events, transport refusal and time are simulated.
The probe executes the public central API. The investigation helper owns the separate production-service probe.
